page.overview:
Who is Malkaan Feirros?

Malkaan Feirros is an Iron Father and the current Master of the Forge of the Iron Hands Chapter. He is also a leading figure of the Iron Hands' Clan Raukaan.

Feirros recently underwent the surgical process known as the Rubicon Primaris to transform from a Firstborn to a Primaris Space Marine.

Known for his age and eccentricity, Feirros is atypical for an Astartes of his Chapter in that he is known for his potent sense of gallows humour.

Perhaps oddly for one so ingrained in the Chapter's most formative rituals, Feirros is considered something of a maverick by his peers upon the Iron Council. He clings to his emotions with a grip no less iron than that of his own left hand, and refuses all augmetics that might ease his transition into a life of pure logic.
